import traceback
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

np.random.seed(0)
df = pd.DataFrame(np.random.rand(10, 5), columns=[f"col{i}" for i in range(5)])
print("df shape:", df.shape, "cols:", list(df.columns))

from ydata_profiling import ProfileReport

# ---------- Part 1: ProfileReport + get_description().scatter ----------
print("\n=== PART 1: ProfileReport(interactions=...) ===")
profile = ProfileReport(
    df,
    interactions={"continuous": True, "targets": ["col0", "col1"]},
    progress_bar=False,
)
print("config.interactions.continuous =", profile.config.interactions.continuous)
print("config.interactions.targets    =", profile.config.interactions.targets)

desc = profile.get_description()
print("type(desc) =", type(desc).__name__)
scatter = desc.scatter
print("type(scatter) =", type(scatter).__name__)
print("OUTER scatter keys =", sorted(scatter.keys()))
for k in sorted(scatter.keys()):
    inner = scatter[k]
    print(f"  inner keys for {k!r} = {sorted(inner.keys())}")
    for ik, v in sorted(inner.items()):
        ok = isinstance(v, str) and len(v) > 0
        print(f"    {k}/{ik}: type={type(v).__name__} len={len(v) if isinstance(v,str) else 'n/a'} nonempty={ok} head={v[:40]!r}" if isinstance(v, str) else f"    {k}/{ik}: {v!r}")

expected_outer = {"col0", "col1"}
expected_inner = {f"col{i}" for i in range(5)}
p1_outer = set(scatter.keys()) == expected_outer
p1_inner = all(set(scatter[k].keys()) == expected_inner for k in scatter)
p1_vals = all(isinstance(v, str) and v for k in scatter for v in scatter[k].values())
print("CHECK outer keys == targets:", p1_outer)
print("CHECK inner keys == all continuous vars:", p1_inner)
print("CHECK all values non-empty str:", p1_vals)

# ---------- Part 2: direct pairwise API ----------
print("\n=== PART 2: ydata_profiling.model.pairwise ===")
from ydata_profiling.model.pairwise import get_scatter_tasks, get_scatter_plot

cont = [f"col{i}" for i in range(5)]
tasks = get_scatter_tasks(profile.config, cont)
print("get_scatter_tasks ->", tasks)
print("n tasks =", len(tasks), "(expected 2 targets * 5 cont = 10)")
tasks_ok = len(tasks) == 10 and {t[0] for t in tasks} == expected_outer and {t[1] for t in tasks} == expected_inner

plot = get_scatter_plot(profile.config, df, "col0", "col3", cont)
print("get_scatter_plot('col0','col3') -> type=%s len=%s head=%r" % (type(plot).__name__, len(plot), plot[:60]))
plot_same = get_scatter_plot(profile.config, df, "col2", "col2", cont)
print("get_scatter_plot('col2','col2') -> type=%s len=%s head=%r" % (type(plot_same).__name__, len(plot_same), plot_same[:60]))
plot_nc = get_scatter_plot(profile.config, df, "not_continuous", "col1", cont)
print("get_scatter_plot(non-continuous x) -> %r" % plot_nc)

plot_ok = isinstance(plot, str) and len(plot) > 0 and isinstance(plot_same, str) and len(plot_same) > 0 and plot_nc == ""

# empty-targets fallback
from ydata_profiling.config import Settings
s2 = Settings()
s2.interactions.continuous = True
s2.interactions.targets = []
t2 = get_scatter_tasks(s2, cont)
print("empty targets -> n tasks =", len(t2), "(expected 25)")
s3 = Settings()
s3.interactions.continuous = False
t3 = get_scatter_tasks(s3, cont)
print("continuous=False -> tasks =", t3, "(expected [])")
fallback_ok = len(t2) == 25 and t3 == []

# ---------- Part 3: render HTML end-to-end ----------
print("\n=== PART 3: to_html() ===")
try:
    html = profile.to_html()
    print("html len =", len(html))
    print("'Interactions' section present:", "Interactions" in html)
    html_ok = len(html) > 10000
except Exception:
    traceback.print_exc()
    html_ok = False

print("\n=== SUMMARY ===")
print("p1_outer", p1_outer, "| p1_inner", p1_inner, "| p1_vals", p1_vals,
      "| tasks_ok", tasks_ok, "| plot_ok", plot_ok, "| fallback_ok", fallback_ok, "| html_ok", html_ok)
print("ALL_PASS =", all([p1_outer, p1_inner, p1_vals, tasks_ok, plot_ok, fallback_ok, html_ok]))
